questions: Are you currently experiencing any pain?
Do you have a history of neck or spine problems?
Did this injury result from a recent accident or fall?
Have you had any numbness or tingling in your arms or legs since the injury?
Is it difficult for you to swallow right now?
orders: Inspect the cervical orthosis and surrounding skin for pressure areas, erythema, or signs of infection
Assess range of motion of the jaw (mouth opening) and check for trismus
Palpate the temporomandibular joints and mandible for tenderness or crepitus
Perform a focused neurological examination of the cranial nerves (specifically V, VII, IX, X, XII)
Obtain a CT scan of the maxillofacial region and cervical spine
